how_to_read: Fields beyond id/title/source: `buzz` = how many DISTINCT outlets carry the same story (corroboration). `seen` = the paper already ran this story on that date: pick it again ONLY if there is a genuinely new fact (a verdict, number, reversal), never for continued interest. `flags` = why a desk editor would be wary (press-release wording, company's own channel, roundup/opinion format, weak fit with the section): treat flagged items as guilty until the text proves a real event. `when` (opportunities) = the real deadline/event date. Is the brain actually 2 nervous systems smooshed together? A new study claims it is.
A recent study may reshape our understanding of brain evolution and open new avenues for studying neurological diseases.
Recent research challenges a long-standing idea about how the brain develops: Rather than arising from a single source, the brain may emerge from two distinct populations of cells, the study finds.

stories.title: H-1B holders from India, China replacing American graduates with cheap labour: US leader | This comes amid US crackdown on H-1B visas | Inshorts
stories.extract:
H-1B holders from India, China replacing American graduates with cheap labour: US leader
US Congressman Riley Moore has called H-1B and OPT programs "scams" that undercut and replace American workers with cheap foreign labor. He added, "650k Americans graduated with computer science related degrees, but they're being replaced by the 500k H1B visa holders who are mostly from China and India. This doesn't make sense. We need to end these scam programs now!"
